from cachetools.tagged import TaggedCache
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore', category=DeprecationWarning)

# Test 1: get returns a deep copy (R01, R06)
c = TaggedCache(3)
c.put('a', [1, 2, 3], ['x'])
v1 = c.get('a')
v2 = c.get('a')
print('Same object on repeated gets:', v1 is v2)  # Should be False per R06
v1.append(4)
v3 = c.get('a')
print('Modifying get result affects cache:', 4 in v3)  # Should be False per R01

# Test 2: nested structures
c2 = TaggedCache(3)
c2.put('b', {'nested': {'deep': 1}}, ['y'])
inner = c2.get('b')
inner['nested']['deep'] = 999
inner2 = c2.get('b')
print('Nested mutation persists:', inner2['nested']['deep'] == 999)  # Should be False
